relations.rationale: The tangled fishing line found in tide pools is the same line described as taking extra care to remove.
The presence of fishing line in tide pools is unrelated to bags being stacked near the entrance in early afternoon.
Dev and Leo being in different houses, given a school with two houses, suggests Leo's house is fixed relative to Dev, but does not determine Yara's house relative to Leo.
House assignments of Dev and Leo have no bearing on the age comparison between Sami and Ivo.
Dev and Leo being in different houses supports the idea that there are at least two houses, consistent with the school having two houses.
Sami's ranking by litter collected could support Yara's team being ahead by midday if litter amount correlates with time-based lead, but ranking is about totals not midday standing.
Sami ranking teams by litter collected doesn't determine or relate to the number of houses in the school.
Ivo arriving slightly after Leo doesn't directly establish timing relative to Dev finishing his second bag, though both describe arrival order.
Ivo's arrival time relative to Dev has no bearing on whether Yara and Leo are in different houses.
Yara and Leo being in different houses is unrelated to the age comparison between Sami and Ivo.
Yara and Leo being in different houses supports the existence of at least two houses, consistent with the school having two houses.
Sami being shorter than Ivo is a physical trait unrelated to the age difference between them.
Sami's height relative to Ivo has no bearing on the number of houses at the school.
Sami being shorter than Ivo has no bearing on everyone gathering for a last look at the shoreline.
Bags being stacked near the entrance by early afternoon is consistent with and supports the later event of everyone gathering before heading home.
